reviews.t: Perfect shaving cream for my downstairs

I don't have a coochy, but I use this for my face. It smells nice and it gives me a nice, smooth shave and leaves my skin feeling soft. I recommend it to everyone.

I gave this 5 stars because I am a repeat buyer. Enough said? Not for Amazon. So...I helped my daughter move and noticed her bottle from last year was almost empty. I needed a new bottle and my other daughter lost the Coochy Cream when her sister moved. The 3-pack was perfect. This seemed to be the best price. It's up to you where you use it but it works great for legs and underarms. A small amount lets your razor glide smoothly and it leaves your skin smooth and soft. I would recommend it.
This shaving gel is great! I used to always get razor burn on my bikini area but I never do anymore!! This smells good and works wonders for shaving!
I will never shave again without it!!! I definitely recommend it to all my friends! You are crazy if you do not try it!

reviews.t: Can't live without it, I WON'T live without it.

I haven't used anything else since, the thought of going back to using soap to shave makes me cringe.  Side note: When my friend and I go rafting up in the literally unnamed regions of Maine and packing the minimum is essential my Coochy Cream doubles as conditioner for our hair, works fantastic.
This is the best shaving cream I have ever used and I refuse to use anything else.  It makes my skin so soft and I hardly ever cut myself.

I used to use this stuff as I bought it from a passion party.  I remember loving it but when I ran out, I never sought to find more.  Well I found this great deal (3 huge bottles for ~$30) and jumped right on it.  I use this stuff to shave everything and it just gives the closest shave.  Before ordering, I was using conditioner, which works great, but this is better.  My legs are still smooth 2 day after shaving and on the 3rd day, just the tiniest bit of (soft) stubble. reviews.t: I have extremely sensitive skin and this product is amazing! I get razor burn often because I couldn't ...
reviews.x: I have extremely sensitive skin and this product is amazing! I get razor burn often because I couldn't find a shaving cream that worked well for me. I heard about this product and I thought I would try it. Once I see a skin product I am interested in, I do a bunch of research before I buy it. Once I realized people were raving about this product, I knew I had to get it. This shaving creme will not let you down. The smell is perfect and not too strong. One bottle lasted me about four months.

I don't have a Coochy, but this works well for my face.  I used to use Jack Black Beard Lube, but it got so expensive that I just couldn't justify it anymore.  This is best alternative I've found.  Sure, the smell is a little feminine, but it leaves your skin feeling soft and smooth and helps prevent razor burn.  Plus, it's not as messy as traditional shaving cream.  I would recommend this to anyone, girl or guy.

This is my wife and daughters favorite product. They love being able to shave their legs with no rash or cuts. I used to get this at an adult store and found this company is a lot cheaper. I am very impressed with their shipping unlike others I have dealt with will use from now on.

This works GREAT on my facial hair, as I have very sensitive skin and can not normally shave everyday or even every other day.  If you are having issues with razor burn, give this a try!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product for leaving skin soft and smooth.
Many reviewers say it prevents razor burn, cuts, or irritation, including those with sensitive skin.
Reviewers commonly mention the pleasant scent.
Several reviewers are repeat buyers or highly recommend it to others.
Some reviewers note the scent is feminine, though it still works for them.
